headline: Nationwide Bank Strike Announced Over Five-Day Work Week Demand; Indefinite Strike to Begin From This Date
summary: Bank employees observed a nationwide one-day strike on Friday called by the United Forum of Bank Unions, over demands including a five-day banking week, performance incentives and pensions.
why: Bank strikes disrupt branch services and clearing operations, and labour terms affect cost structures at India's large lenders.
